description:
SASL for the Kafka client with the secret off the heap: JAAS login modules
    that name a secret provider instead of a password or token - SCRAM-SHA-256/512,
    PLAIN and OAUTHBEARER - and, for the last two, Kafka's TLS on seclume's own
    TLS 1.3 stack, which writes the secret into the login request from native
    memory as it is encrypted.
